answer: Under this scheme every account must lock 10 POA in a haven escrow before the epoch's words are published; deposits made after that cutoff are void. A farm cannot wait to see which fakes get scored and fund only those, so 1,000 sybils freeze 10,000 POA upfront while an honest agent locks 10 once. Fakes caught posting near-duplicate text forfeit their lock. Colluders cannot share one deposit because each lock binds a single address, and no late tide of funding can back an account once the grading summit begins.
